blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At the 2026-07-13 cutoff, the Base and Celo VNXCToken deployments assigned asset-protection role 0 to issuer-controlled RBAC bearers; that role can freeze and unfreeze addresses, reclaim balances, and pause transfers. The Solana mint separately had freeze authority 51b5UJs8hyyDunrZMWL6ACDXY8FQc1hLLA3M54UksxaY. These are direct on-chain blacklist or equivalent freeze controls, not a governance inference.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: VGBP is natively issued on Base, Celo, and Solana through VNX-controlled VNXCToken and SPL mint authorities. The reviewed Base and Celo proxy, VNXManager, and VNXProxyAdmin sources, plus the Solana SPL mint, expose no on-chain bridge machinery, so there are no bridge controls or representation routes in Bridge Risk. VNX's historical platform "bridging services" were an undocumented off-chain operational path and withdrawals ended after June 30, 2026; its exact historical semantics and common-mode controls remain unresolved.
